description:
Modern research reproducibility requires citing software and datasets. Create a new collection named 'Reproducibility Data'. Inside this collection, manually create two new items using the 'New Item > More...' menu:

1. A 'Computer Program' item:
   - Title: Scikit-learn
   - Version: 1.0.2
   - System: Python
   - URL: https://scikit-learn.org
   - Company/Publisher: Scikit-learn Developers

2. A 'Dataset' item:
   - Title: MNIST Database
   - Date: 1998
   - Repository: Courant Institute
   - URL: http://yann.lecun.com/exdb/mnist/

The task is complete when the collection exists and contains these two specific items with the correct metadata fields populated.
